description: Smart Meter Data-Driven Evaluation of Operational Demand Response Potential of Residential Air Conditioning Loads is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Ning Qi. The ground truth data used in this paper are obtained from three different areas to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed methods. The detailed data information is described as follows: 1) The ground truth data from the Pecan Street dataset are collected from real households in the Muller project in Austin, TX, USA. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
